resources.string: Starting dimensions give you a starting point for assembly. A published cut list is specific to the parts and mounting of that design. Simulation plots describe the antenna under the conditions specified in the model.
Scaling a reference design by frequency also changes conductor diameters and gaps. If you change the material, diameter or mounting, choose a suitable design variant and verify its performance.
4nec2 works with NEC‑2 and NEC‑4. MMANA‑GAL Basic uses a modified MININEC‑3 engine. Choose segment lengths to suit the geometry and follow the guidance for your solver.

An S1P trace shows reflection at the measurement port. Interpret SWR and input impedance at the stated reference plane. Use the same plane to compare measurements. Assess gain and front-to-back ratio separately through field measurements or simulation.
